w:r.w:t: This document presents a description of ONGC’s requirements to view progress of their well planning process in a dashboard.

Each wellbore design is tracked through the following milestones, stored with a full date-and-time stamp:
Standard wells track all 11 milestones. Well Montage designs only require 2 levels of approval, so they track 10 milestones and are considered complete once
Completion rule: a well is marked Completed the moment its final approval level is logged (
for Well Montage) - even if an earlier step such as the Fluids-team or Cementing hand-off was never entered.
